analysis.reason: 3거래일 연속 관망 유지. RSI는 과매도 구간 진입 중이며, MACD 히스토그램은 악화세를 보이며 음전환. ADX는 9.6으로 추세가 형성되지 않은 무추세 구간으로, 변동성 확대 가능성 염두에 둔다. 5일 저가와 20일 저가가 동일하며 5일 고가가 20일 고가보다 낮아 Lower High 패턴이 형성되며 약세 전환 가능성 시사. 1,678,000원 스윙 지지선 하향 이탈 시 추가 하락 가능성.
analysis.reasonEn: Maintaining a wait-and-see approach for 3 consecutive trading days. RSI is entering oversold territory, and the MACD histogram is worsening and turning negative. ADX is at 9.6, indicating a range-bound market without a clear trend, suggesting potential for increased volatility. The 5-day low matches the 20-day low, and the 5-day high is lower than the 20-day high, indicating a Lower High pattern and hinting at a potential bearish reversal. A break below the 1,678,000 swing support level could lead to further declines.

analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price (KRW 1,681,000) vs SMA5 (KRW 1,770,200) / SMA20 (KRW 1,789,600) / SMA50 (KRW 1,678,322): Below SMA50, diagnosing short-to-mid-term trend as weak.
· Position relative to SMA100 (KRW 1,938,490) / SMA200 (KRW 1,434,975): Below SMA100, potential for long-term trend to turn weak.
· 52-week position (49.1%) + Current price level near historical midpoint.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (51.2→43.7): Entering oversold, strengthening downward momentum.
· MACD histogram trajectory (457.2468→-13087.1262): Worsening, confirming bearish reversal.
· Bollinger Bands current price position (Lower Band KRW 1,670,335): Approaching lower band, potential for further decline.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing Support (KRW 1,678,000): Aligns with SMA50, risk of breakdown if breached.
· Swing Resistance (KRW 1,890,000): Expect short-term rebound if broken.
· 5-day/20-day High/Low Pattern (Lower High formation): Strengthening bearish trend.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume Ratio (1.53x): Increased volume relative to price decline, raising confidence in the downtrend.
· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation Phase): Multiple bearish reversal signals confirmed, maintaining wait-and-see stance.
